title: Cats Cove
description: A create oriented modpack for the server Cats Cove.
body:
# Welcome!

This modpack is intended to be played on the server Cats Cove! If you want to join then feel free, just go to multiplayer and it'll be there. You can also join us on [discord](https://discord.gg/cy6v9Qfvey)!

## Overview

The pack is focused on create, having many building and detail mods centered around it. There's furniture, machinery, and even a few quest lines! There's many beautiful sights to look and build at thanks to the biome and terrain mods.

## Core Mods

- **Create!**.. *and a slew of add-ons* 😅.
- **AERONAUTICS!!!**
- Food mods like **Farmer's Delight** and **Some Assembly Required**.
- World Gen mods such as **Nature's Spirit** and **Tectonic**.
- VR Support using **Vivecraft** and some compatibility mods. You **WILL** need a good computer for this.
- **Simple Voice Chat**, letting you communicate with your voice, not just text!
- A ton of client-side mods that add to the whole ambience, adding more sounds and effects.
